---
id: implement-tracking-tags
name: Implement tracking tags
description: Add analytics/marketing tags (UTM params, pixels, tag manager events) for a campaign
requires:
  connectors: [analytics]
---

## When to use
Once a GTM plan defines what needs to be measured.

## Steps
1. Define UTM parameter conventions for each channel/link.
2. Add or update tag manager events for key campaign actions.
3. Verify tags fire correctly in a staging/preview environment.
4. Document the tagging scheme so results are attributable per channel.

## Done when
- Every campaign channel's traffic and key actions are attributable in analytics.
